description:
The Development of Playfield under the Chief Minister's Samagra Makkal Thittam or CMSGUY is a significant initiative launched by the Government of Tamil Nadu. 

This scheme was introduced in 2021 as part of a broader effort to promote sports and physical activities among the youth of the state. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to develop playfields in urban and rural areas across Tamil Nadu. 

The government aims to create at least one playfield in every village and urban locality. 

This initiative is designed to encourage children and youth to engage in sports and outdoor activities. 

The scheme also aims to improve the overall health and fitness levels of the population. 

The Tamil Nadu government has allocated a budget of ₹1,000 crores for the implementation of this scheme. 

This funding is intended to cover the development of playfields, including the construction of necessary facilities and infrastructure. 

The playfields are expected to include various sports facilities such as cricket pitches, football grounds, basketball courts, and other recreational areas. 

The target is to establish around 12,000 playfields across the state within a span of three years. 

The scheme also focuses on promoting traditional sports and games that are culturally significant to Tamil Nadu. 

Eligibility for the scheme is broad, as it is aimed at all residents of Tamil Nadu, particularly children and youth aged between 6 to 25 years. 

There are no specific income criteria for beneficiaries under this scheme. 

The application process for the Development of Playfield under CMSGUY is relatively straightforward. 

Local bodies such as village panchayats and urban local bodies are responsible for submitting proposals for the development of playfields. 

These proposals must include details about the location, type of sports facilities to be developed, and estimated costs. 

The required documents for the application include a resolution from the local body, land ownership documents, and a detailed project report. 

Once the proposal is submitted, it is reviewed by the respective district sports authorities. 

The timeline for the development of playfields is set to be completed within a year of the proposal's approval. 

Disbursement of funds is done in phases based on the progress of the construction. 

The first phase involves the release of 50% of the allocated funds upon approval. 

The remaining funds are released upon successful completion of the project. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Tamil Nadu Sports Development Authority. 

They are responsible for overseeing the development of playfields and ensuring compliance with the guidelines. 

The contact details for the Tamil Nadu Sports Development Authority can be found on their official website. 

This initiative is part of a larger vision to promote sports culture in Tamil Nadu. 

The government believes that access to playfields will help nurture sporting talent at the grassroots level. 

In addition to physical benefits, the scheme aims to foster teamwork and discipline among young people. 

The initiative also aligns with the National Sports Policy of India, which emphasizes the importance of sports in education and community development. 

The government has also partnered with various sports organizations to provide training and coaching at these playfields. 

This collaboration aims to ensure that the facilities are utilized effectively for skill development. 

Moreover, the scheme is expected to create employment opportunities for local youth in coaching and facility management. 

The initiative is also seen as a way to reduce screen time among children and promote outdoor activities. 

The government has set up a monitoring mechanism to evaluate the progress of playfield development. 

Regular inspections will be conducted to ensure that the facilities meet the required standards. 

Feedback from the community will also be taken into account to improve the facilities. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from various stakeholders, including parents and educators. 

They believe that access to playfields will significantly contribute to the holistic development of children. 

The government has also emphasized the importance of maintaining these playfields after their development. 

Local bodies will be responsible for the upkeep and management of the facilities. 

They are expected to organize regular sports events and activities to keep the community engaged. 

In conclusion, the Development of Playfield under CMSGUY is a comprehensive initiative aimed at enhancing sports infrastructure in Tamil Nadu. 

With a significant budget allocation and clear objectives, the scheme seeks to create a healthier and more active population. 

By focusing on accessibility and community involvement, the government aims to foster a culture of sports and physical fitness among the youth. 

This initiative is a step towards building a stronger sporting ecosystem in the state. 

It reflects the government's commitment to promoting sports as an integral part of education and community life. 

The success of this scheme will depend on effective implementation and active participation from local communities. 

The government is optimistic that this initiative will lead to the discovery of new sporting talent in Tamil Nadu. 

As the scheme progresses, it will be crucial to monitor its impact on youth engagement in sports and overall health outcomes. 

The Development of Playfield under CMSGUY is a forward-thinking initiative that addresses the need for recreational spaces in both urban and rural settings. 

It is a vital part of Tamil Nadu's strategy to promote sports and physical education for future generations.
